title: Remove login and make the app publicly usable by everyone

requirements.text: Update the React app so it does not require Internet Identity login to use the reminders and messaging features; the main app UI must be accessible immediately on load.

quotes: with l no login used for everyone

acceptanceCriteria: When opening the app in a fresh browser session, the user can access Reminders and Messages without seeing a login gate screen.
No UI flow blocks usage due to missing authentication (e.g., no forced login prompts).

requirements.text: Remove or disable all login/logout and first-time profile setup UI flows (including the login button and profile setup dialog) so the interface reflects a shared/public mode.

quotes: with l no login used for everyone

acceptanceCriteria: The header no longer shows a Login/Logout control.
The app does not prompt users to set up a profile name before using the app.
Any user-facing text referencing “Login with Internet Identity” or “Recipient’s Internet Identity Principal” is removed or replaced with public-mode wording in English.

requirements.text: Change backend authorization logic so anonymous (unauthenticated) callers can create, read, update, and delete reminders, and can send/read/delete messages without receiving authorization traps.

quotes: with l no login used for everyone

acceptanceCriteria: Backend calls for reminders/messages succeed for anonymous callers (no Runtime.trap with Unauthorized messages for normal usage).
Existing reminders/messages CRUD endpoints continue to function, but no longer require Internet Identity login.

requirements.text: Adjust messaging and “send reminder as message” UX to work in shared/public mode without requiring users to enter Principal IDs.

quotes: with l no login used for everyone

acceptanceCriteria: The message composer does not require a recipient Principal ID field to send a message.
The “Send Reminder as Message” dialog does not require a recipient Principal ID field to send a reminder message.
Messages view remains usable without a user principal (e.g., it does not rely on per-user inbox/sent filtering that breaks without login).

constraints: Backend must remain a single-actor Motoko canister (all logic in backend/main.mo).
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (compose them only).
Do not edit immutable paths: frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.tsx, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, frontend/src/components/ui.
nonGoals: Adding any new authentication provider (only Internet Identity exists, and this request removes the need to use it).
Implementing per-user private data separation without login (this request is for shared/public access).
Adding external databases or off-chain persistence.
